posts.subject: Daddy Tang's admin application
posts.bodyHtml:
0) Do I meet the requirements?


Actually yes, you will decide if my application can be approved or not =)


_______________________________


1) What is your name? Real & Ingame


My real name is Marco, in game is Daddy Tang


2) How old are you?


Yesterday was my 20th birthday =) it's just... wonderful 😄 😄


3) Why do you want to join our administrative team?


I want to join your administrative team because i'd like to help you but mostly because i think this is a beautiful community of friendly people, and, trust me, i've seen many communities like this but i liked this one the most; i want to join your administrative team also because sometimes, in the knife server, "bad" people join and insult other players when the admin is offline... i play much time a day in the knife server and if someone needs me i will be always ready to help. =)


4) How long have you been playing on our servers?


I started in the 2014 with another account, which is now closed for several reasons. I've got so many hours and experience on your server =)


5) What are your favourite hobbies or pastimes?



My favourite hobby is playing tennis; i'm a very tennis junkie, i play it three or four times a week. I also like dancing in the disco and, of course, studying. Of course i like playing video games (maybe i like it the most). And of course, making love (who doesn't?) xD




6) Do you think of yourself as mature?



Yes, i think so. Many times people tell me i'm not, but i just ignore them. I study a lot and honestly i help other people too much and, like i always say, everyone has got his own idea of me and of the world so everyone is free to think whatever he wants.



7) Have you gained experience as an administrator before?



Yes, i did. A little time ago a friend wanted to open a server and i was the administrator. Unfortunately the server closed and i lost my administrative position.



[8)] When do you play? (timetable of your average week)



I play a lot of time a day, everyday (of course except when i'm at holiday) about 3 or 4 hours a day (yeah, also 5 or 6), always on your knife server; i don't play cs go (mm) anymore, so i'm always there.



9) User 1 calls user 2 a "cunt" and proceeds to insult him further - what actions would you take?



First i try to understand why User 1 is calling user 2 a "cunt", after that he explained me it i'll give him another chance (or more, it depends by what he has done); if the problem is serious and he does it twice, three times or more, i'l take my decision. Serious = kick; much serious = ban



10) Strengths



I am comprehensive, patient and funny. to talk to; i'm a person who makes another person thinking about what he has just done; i'm also a good knifer (i think) if it can affect =)


11) Weaknesses


Sometimes i can be a little bit stubborn about something and (it can also be a strenght) if i take my final decision, it's unchangeable.


12) Conclusion / Closing remark



I really hope my application has satisfied you, i'm really interested to help this community. If you want to make me test admin, i'll show you that you didn't do anything wrong =) thanks for reading, i wish you a good evening. Marco

It's a no from my side, simply because I don't know you.
I've never seen you on the server or the TeamSpeak and you only registered on the forum to post your application.


Zitat von Daddy Tang

4) How long have you been playing on our servers? I started in the 2014 with another account, which is now closed for several reasons. I've got so many hours and experience on your server =)

Can you tell us the reason it got closed or at least your current ingame name and the ingame name of your old account, so that I actually might have the chance to recognize you if you are really playing since 2014?


Edit: The Knife server was created in April 2015, so you probably are not playing since 2014 🙂
Source: 07.04.15

I dont know you but your application is very simple , copy & paste .
Also i never saw you on the Dream Teamspeak Server .
NO
Sure, my name was Andykiller90; it has been closed because i received (cod) cheats from someone (that i didn't know) and the profile has been banned.
I started playing there when ShroudX was admin

Andykiller90, oh yeah, I actually know you. It's true that you have been playing for some quite time on the server, but I haven't seen you in recent times.
The knife server was also created in April 2015, so you probably are not playing since 2014, click here for the source.


Also, if your other profile got VAC in Call of Duty, you still should be able to play CSGO unless you are lying to us.
Even if you don't want to and want a clear profile, I have to tell you, that you can unfortunately not apply as an Administrator.


There is a requirement, that you cannot apply as an administrator, if you have an VAC ban.
For some reason, it's missing from the english requirements and is only present in the german ones, I will add it shortly.
THANKS anyway =) i'm pretty sure it was 2014; it's the year when my profile was born; but ok maybe my memory is fuc*ed up 😛 right, it was 2015 lol

Reopened, since I have new information.


@Doo Doo contacted him on Steam and has provided me with screenshots in which Daddy Tang confirms that he is not Andykiller90 but instead just a 16 year old guy who is pretty new to CS and just wanted to be an admin for the powers.


Therefore the application is rejected.
